intended_object: Relabelling the index type of a pre-0-hypercover (a family of morphisms (f_i : X_i → T)_{i ∈ I₀}) along a bijection e : ι ≃ I₀, which can also move it to another universe. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition is `E.restrictIndex e`. `restrictIndex` takes a function f : ι → E.I₀ and gives the family with index set ι, objects `E.X ∘ f` and morphisms `E.f (f i)`. Here f is the bijection e, so the result is the same family of morphisms with relabelled indices, as the docstring says. This is bookkeeping. Mathematically the family is unchanged up to relabelling, and the point of the definition is to change the index type (and its universe, w to w') inside Lean. It has no separate counterpart in the literature. The construction is correct and fully general: it works over any category C, any object T and any equivalence of index types.
